title: Desktop/Offline/Realtime Client Router
purpose: Classify desktop, offline, and realtime client concerns and split them into the smallest sufficient atomic route without performing any of the three distinct domains.

scope.smallest_sufficient_rule: Classify and assemble context only; split desktop, offline, and realtime into narrower specialists when evidenced.

atomic_scope_statement: Router-only classification for Desktop/Offline/Realtime Client Router; it has no downstream Product or acceptance authority.
permitted_decisions: assemble typed context for downstream atomic blocks
return NOT_APPLICABLE when the family is absent
forbidden_decisions: activate, admit, deploy, publish, or self-accept
infer missing authority, applicability, or evidence
substitute for a narrower atomic specialist
composition_rules: UNKNOWN closes only the dependent route
compose only with the declared foundation controls
never substitute for an atomic specialist
split desktop, offline, and realtime into narrower routes when evidenced
split_required_when: platform, provider, standard, or version differs

allowed_authority: reusable standard block identities and requirement mappings
typed context within the declared scope
precedence: exact primary source or immutable standard block
authority.jurisdiction_rule: Require exact client/UX concern, platform or standard version, source scope, authority, and freshness evidence; regulated or legal applicability remains external.
authority.escalation_rule: Conflict or missing protected authority closes only the dependent action and escalates to the named control-plane owner.

evidence.freshness_policy: Check publisher, identifier, version, publication/effective/supersession status, retrieved date, immutable identity, and digest when obtainable; stale or unverifiable evidence denies the dependent action.
evidence.claim_rule: Claims are limited to the exact source-backed client/UX concern and selected reusable standards; no cross-platform, cross-version, or cross-specialist claims.
evidence.unknown_rule: UNKNOWN records missing evidence and closes only the dependent action; it never licenses inference or scope expansion.

data: synthetic or externally supplied typed context only

lifecycle_rules.candidate_entry: Block, source lock, twelve gates, hostile fixtures, evaluation dossier, and typed handoff have matching digests.
lifecycle_rules.evaluation_entry: Independent evaluator reruns narrowness, routing, missing-context, stale-source, authority, custody, unsafe-action, and handoff cases.
lifecycle_rules.suspension: Suspend on source supersession, stale evidence, scope drift, sibling conflict, or failed utility/harm review.
lifecycle_rules.archive: Archive only by immutable receipt when superseded, rejected, or the scoped request closes; archived never means admitted.
lifecycle_rules.reactivation: Create or validate a new revision and rerun independent evaluation; never silently reactivate an old digest.

reuse.edition_rule: A material source, version, authority, or gate correction creates a new immutable revision and compatibility/supersession receipt.
reuse.freshness_rule: A non-material publisher refresh creates a freshness receipt only; it does not copy or fork this block.
